riskAssessment.reason: Leaving a stale red snapshot can falsely signal an active blocker, while deleting the wrong record could damage historical evidence. The change is limited to the generated live cockpit index and its orphan status snapshot; archived records remain immutable.
riskAssessment.reviewedBy: Codex under the user's explicit full-lifecycle remediation authorization
riskAssessment.destructiveChangeReview: The two generated live snapshot files are deleted because they identify a nonexistent branch and are not authoritative archive records; the exact prior content remains recoverable from Git history.

acceptance: The live .ai/cockpit/work-items index and orphan wi-06-status-interface snapshot no longer report a nonexistent current Work Item.
The authoritative .ai/work-items/archive/index.json and all archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, and manifest records remain unchanged.

guidelines: Generated cockpit state must be produced or removed through repository lifecycle tooling; do not hand-edit current_status.md.
Archived Work Item records are immutable and must not be rewritten to make the live index look clean.
Keep the change limited to governance snapshots; do not alter product code, tests, dependencies, workflows, or quality gates.

intent.problem: The repository's tracked live Cockpit index still contains a red status for wi-06-status-interface, with a branch and evidence base from 2026-08-16. That Work Item is not present in the authoritative archive index, has no local or remote branch, and is not an active Contract/Summary pair. The stale snapshot can make current governance appear blocked even though the repository is at a clean main state.
constraints: Preserve every archived Work Item record and the authoritative archive index.
Do not change Rust behavior, tests, dependencies, workflows, provider configuration, or external services.
Use the canonical Work Item lifecycle and record the user's granted scope for PR, hosted checks, merge, and close.
intent.rationale: The stale files are generated live cockpit projections, not historical Work Item evidence. Removing only the orphan projection and index clears the false current blocker while preserving immutable archive evidence and the normal no-active Work Item state.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized the full remediation loop and requested that any required authorization be recorded in the Contract; this approval covers only the two orphan live Cockpit snapshot paths.
